summary: Source review found no product defect: the desktop-scoped CSS follows the spec, preserves the merged separate save-row placement, full labels and handlers, leaves mobile rules and shared navigation untouched, and provides wrapping and metadata ellipsis. The current Playwright suite meaningfully covers the agreed bilingual width matrix, connected and long-metadata states, pointer/keyboard access, and mobile regressions; root npm test discovers all 66 task cases (223 overall). Static verification and git diff --check passed. However, independent browser verification was blocked before the first page executed: Chromium aborted at sandbox_host_linux.cc:41 with shutdown: Operation not permitted; 65 cases did not run after the first launch failure. The regression runner also could not start because bwrap could not create a NETLINK_ROUTE socket. The tester reports 66 successful cases, but the retained browser report contains only 53 historical passes. Approval remains blocked on current executable verification evidence, not a demonstrated layout regression. The reports' Git commit blocker is no longer outstanding: implementation commit 8eaa1a4 and tester commit ae0cf4e are present, and the working tree was clean at review start.
findings: In an authorized environment where Chromium and the team sandbox can launch, complete final verification of the current branch with npm test -- tests/02-adapt-the-menu-for-small-screens/laptop-header.spec.js and the required gdsync, wbsaveall, task-01 row and task-03 buttons regression suites. Retain the current 66-case browser report, geometry attachments and requested screenshots under the task directory, replacing or explicitly superseding the historical 53-case artifacts; update the reports with the actual results before requesting merge approval. Do not change product CSS to work around the review environment restrictions.
